_comment: Source list for the publisher. Edit this, put the HTML in src/m/<class>/, then run: node study/tools/publish.mjs. Hidden/locked flags are not here: those are live switches in the hub's admin panel.

materials.title: The Fifty States: name and locate
materials.blurb: Numbered blank-map quiz with spaced repetition and a readiness score.

materials.title: Fraser Ch 1-2: reading quiz prep
materials.blurb: Guide with the chapters' own review questions, a 10-question multiple-choice quiz (5 per chapter, excerpt-based), fresh mocks from an 81-item bank, a typed recall drill, the written set, and printable sheets.

materials.title: The Elements: symbol and name
materials.blurb: Sets of ten drilled both ways, on a live periodic table, with a settings page and a mastery rule that wants evidence over several days.

materials.title: Unit 1 Sequences: checkpoint prep
materials.blurb: Guide by skill, instant-feedback drill, the 14-problem practice set in the teacher's style, timed mock quizzes with fresh numbers, a focus box that tracks weak skills, and printable sheets with separate keys.
